results.title: A changed verse is caught
results.checks: John 3:16 is altered on its way to the browser (its published fingerprint left as it was; John 3 reached from John 2, so it is fetched): the badge says Check failed, verse 16 — and only 16 — is marked, and the sheet names it
results.note: Check failed; only verse 16 marked; the sheet names it
